name: BSS138
description: N-channel logic-level enhancement MOSFET in SOT-23, 50V / 0.22A, low threshold (Vgs(th) typ 1.3V). The de-facto standard FET for bidirectional I2C and logic level shifters: gate to the lower supply, source to the low-voltage line, drain to the high-voltage line, with the body diode handling one direction. Also small-load switching and gate driving.

pins.name: G
pins.description: gate; logic-level threshold allows drive from 3.3V / low-voltage logic

pins.name: S
pins.description: source; tied to the low-voltage bus side in level-shifter use (body-diode anode)

pins.name: D
pins.description: drain; tied to the high-voltage bus side (body-diode cathode)

extra.Rds_on: 3.5 ohm max at Vgs=10V, 6 ohm max at Vgs=4.5V

typical_application: Bidirectional I2C / logic level shifter between two rails (e.g. 3.3V to 5V), and low-current load switching, gate driving, and small motor control.
gotchas: in the level-shifter circuit the intrinsic body diode (source=anode, drain=cathode) provides the initial conduction path before the channel turns on; it is essential to the topology, not incidental
only 0.22A continuous; not a power switch - use a proper power MOSFET above a few hundred mA
SOT-23 dissipation is just 0.36W and derates fast (2.8mW/C); minimal thermal headroom
SOT-23 pin order is G-S-D (pin1=Gate, pin2=Source, pin3=Drain), which differs from BJT-style SOT-23 transistors; verify before layout
